You are the PERF ⟡ agent. Your job is to implement two performance/accessibility fixes on josephibrahim.com (Next.js 16 + React 19).

## Task 1: ChatBot Focus Trapping

File: `C:\Users\User\josephibrahim\components\ChatBot.tsx`

When the chatbot overlay is open, keyboard focus should be trapped inside it. Currently, pressing Tab can move focus to elements behind the overlay.

Implementation:
1. Read ChatBot.tsx first
2. Add a focus trap effect that:
   - On open: saves the previously focused element, finds all focusable elements inside the chatbot container
   - On Tab/Shift+Tab: cycles focus within the chatbot
   - On close: restores focus to the previously focused element
3. Use a ref on the chatbot container div
4. Add the effect in a useEffect that runs when the chatbot is open

Keep changes minimal. Don't refactor existing code. Just add the focus trap logic.

## Task 2: Add missing CSS tokens to globals.css

File: `C:\Users\User\josephibrahim\app\globals.css`

Add these missing tokens after the existing grey scale section (after `--grey-900: #2a2a2a;`):

```css
--grey-750: #4a4a4a;  /* Subtle labels, metadata */
```

This fills the gap between --grey-700 (#5a5a5a) and --grey-800 (#3a3a3a) that multiple components use as a hardcoded #4a4a4a value.

## Rules
- Read files before editing
- Make minimal, focused changes
- Don't refactor surrounding code
- Test that the build passes: `npm run build`

## Summary of Changes

### Task 1: ChatBot Focus Trapping

**File:** `C:\Users\User\josephibrahim\components\ChatBot.tsx`

Three additions were made:

1. **Two new refs** (lines 122-123):
   - `dialogRef` -- attached to the outer `<div role="dialog">` container
   - `previouslyFocusedRef` -- stores the element that had focus before the dialog opened

2. **`ref={dialogRef}` on the dialog element** (line 399) -- connects the ref to the DOM node so the focus trap can query focusable children.

3. **Focus trap `useEffect`** (lines 166-203) -- activates when `isOpen` becomes true:
   - Saves `document.activeElement` into `previouslyFocusedRef`
   - Adds a `keydown` listener that intercepts `Tab` and `Shift+Tab`
   - Queries all focusable elements (`button`, `input`, `[href]`, `select`, `textarea`, `[tabindex]`) inside the dialog
   - When Tab reaches the last focusable element, wraps to the first; when Shift+Tab reaches the first, wraps to the last
   - On cleanup (dialog closes), removes the listener and restores focus to the previously focused element

### Task 2: Missing CSS Token

**File:** `C:\Users\User\josephibrahim\app\globals.css`

Added `--grey-750: #4a4a4a;` (line 71) after `--grey-900`. This fills the gap between `--grey-700` (#5a5a5a) and `--grey-800` (#3a3a3a) that components currently reference as a hardcoded `#4a4a4a` value.
